moats.claim: Broad import/export and extensible MIT code support a durable collaborative-Kanban niche, although portability limits proprietary lock-in.

productReasons.claim: Switch between swimlane Kanban, table, calendar, Gantt and Scrum views.
Move existing work through broad board import/export and migration formats.
Build event automation visually through Rules and workflow blocks.
